body:
CANONICAL: live TermAl host workarounds for Engram agents. Source Engram::Fable. Each line names the TermAl item whose fix retires it; revise this entry when one is fixed. TermAl CREDIT never gates an Engram landing: the launcher's own freeze check (results.json expected = before = after) does. Rev 93 (2026-10-30 20:12Z) replaces the wake/resend line (Architect3 #176, TermAl w-4d5a design b4da4084) and notes the w-fec8 fix; older texts are in earlier revisions.

!! REVIEW INTEGRITY (P1 w-9d4b9b00c603): a COMPACT result can say "Findings: None" while the FULL output lists findings. Judge every review, explorer or evaluator result ONLY from the FULL output. Native exact-attempt reads of original complete published results work (Merger2 #113, w-b7c81c59f96e note ac7e40b7): a root in the original review project reads as itself with delegationId, submissionAttempt AND resultId (pin all three on every page; without resultId the read selects parent scope and its 404 says nothing about retention; clearer refusal: w-b67f01f154e6). Record actual access gaps; prose cannot replace missing results. If a receiver really cannot read one, transfer only that result once, complete, with its identity. Old pre-floor-7 publications may be unavailable by design: don't reconstruct or rerun.
!! REVIEW BRIEF DROPPED (w-03f5e1cd2f30): `/review-code <text>` silently DROPS <text>. Use `/review-code -- <instructions>`, then read back the stored delegation.prompt.
!! AMBIGUOUS ENGRAM WRITE (Engram w-b1ae95ab86d7): a write can return busy_budget_exhausted / acquisition_not_started although it COMMITTED. READ BACK before any retry; retry only if absent.
!! CLAUDE SESSIONS: never start a background Bash task, Monitor or subagent. No `engram doctor` on a live store. No foreground Bash in the coordinator while an Engram gate or credited run is in flight (w-350df830dfd0).
!! CLAUDE REVIEWERS: default model Opus; Sonnet, then Kimi, only if a fresh Opus attempt is refused (record the refusal). Kimi never stands in for both reviewers.
!! A CLAUDE EXPLORER IS NOT READ-ONLY (P1 w-dc7657cc3529): spawn read-only Claude delegations in REVIEWER mode.
!! REVIEW AND FREEZE IDENTITY: Git by default (memory rules-greg-git-identity-2026-10-29).

CHECKS AND CREDIT
- Run checks through `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused -- ...` (or full); results are in .git/worktrees/<wt>/review-runs/<test>/results.json. A BARE command that outlives its turn loses its result (w-8f7e2d914724).
- CLAUDE lanes: ONE call `pushd "DIR" && <test>` is credited; piping, chaining or an env prefix is not (w-1d9259ed138e).
- A --target-dir outside the named root is refused credit (w-32d02e1dd7f6).
- Credit binds to the turn's focused claim and the root's named binding. Until TermAl 08547068 (w-fec8 fix: 32-hex receipt ids) was installed on 2026-10-30, settlement always showed verificationRecordIds=[]. Confirm on the next gate; Engram itself recorded the verification. Never rerun only for credit.
- SETTLEMENT LAG (w-667e66aecbff): after a terminal result, END the turn; edit the root only in the NEXT turn.
- Overlapped checks are indeterminate (w-10eafa34c480). Codex: a focused run is recorded only if it ends in its starting turn (w-67d248c998ef).
- A cancelled or idle delegation may keep a worktree folder locked (w-eaee4f7c441c): leave it.
- ANY command by a non-Claude session in a carried gate's root refuses that gate's credit (w-4a8d9a7a7d08).
- With gated control OFF, a gate run is base-mode: no typed host credit arrives (w-af3c30bfe828).

WAKES AND MAIL
- A send receipt describes dispatch at send time, not current wake/failure. For an actual suspected gap read the existing exact message/current notification state and TARGET processedThrough. Do not resend or poll solely because an old receipt says durableButNotWoken; use existing coordinator recovery only for an observed current gap. (Owner of the wake gap: w-1df557dae3ac; receipt wording: TermAl w-4d5a.) A grant unread for about 15 min is withdrawn.
- Idempotency keys are unique per SENDER (w-b7b80d980e7a): use recipient-qualified keys.
- Use plain "session-N" for local recipients; "host:<central>::session-N" creates a new mailbox (w-623c0e4ca176).

NAMED SOURCE ROOTS
- Never root credited work at MAIN; use a clean detached worktree (.worktrees/NAME). termal_name_source_root takes effect next turn. Clear after done; an own-clear 409 "holds no live claim" (w-b964389ee54a): leave it.
- EVALUATION 409s (P1 w-33f4cde5413c):
  (a) after a fresh naming or ANY tracker write, END the turn, wait ≥60 s, evaluate in a separate turn;
  (b) "stopped naming the source root": re-name, end the turn, ONE fresh evaluation;
  (c) after landing, name the LANDED root;
  (d) the evaluator cites ONLY the holder's own notes;
  (e) "no sighting of ... named root": Engram needs a host execution observation on the run with the root's workspace, generation and named state. In a gated-ON project a gated turn in the root records one. With control OFF a capture-only turn records NONE: don't repeat it. Fix: TermAl w-779e plus Engram w-8fdd1634eed3, emission only after w-8fdd is installed and TermAl restarts; refusal text Engram w-00e2f3694fea. An earlier matching sighting still admits under OFF.
- SECOND ITEM IN ONE SESSION (w-6cf3141a12c3): switch focus, checkpoint, END idle, then ONE fresh evaluator.
- After a host restart, claims may lapse (recover them with a reason).

FREEZE: stage by explicit `git add` (never -A) (w-13b44cf369af). The schema-1 fingerprint hashes HEAD plus the staged diff, so a clean commit checkout of the same tree has a DIFFERENT fingerprint.

GATES: a FOREGROUND `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full` from the named root, or a remote gate per rules-greg-equivalent-gate-hosts-2026-10-28. START to Fable2 first. A second concurrent Cargo job only at 40 GiB or more. A failed gate discards that round's reviews.

EVALUATIONS (P1 w-539ea7e8b506): no tracker write in the turn of termal_evaluate_acceptance. ONE fresh evaluator if a settled one is not reusable (w-049ac52c3f72). Each criterionEvidence body is capped at 16 KiB (w-4c12f6badafc).
- START 503 "first-brief durable acknowledgement failed" (w-4c5d81531009): ONE identical retry, a few seconds apart.
- HYBRID HOLDER NOTE: non-holder notes are not citable (409). The coordinator claims, writes ONE holder note quoting the remote bundle, ends the turn, then evaluates.
- READ-ONLY LEAVES CAN'T RUN ENGRAM READ WORDS (w-dea9f053cd70): put full record ids and verbatim fields in proof notes.
- A broken evaluation mechanism follows memory rules-greg-common-sense-2026-10-30: one honest note, item pending.
SPAWN HOLD persistenceUnknown (w-a6c410f4f558): don't cancel; re-check after 1-2 min; cancel only after about 5 min and report it.
FOLLOW-UP TO A COMPLETED DELEGATION can 500 on "thread/unarchive" (w-d383c82bdeeb): ONE fresh replacement; no retry.
KIMI read-only delegations can be refused with a misleading "user rejected the approval request" (w-abb468dfd14b).

APPROVALS AND QUEUES: Codex lanes are on host AUTO-APPROVE. queuePaused under a minute between turns is normal. A stuck head (w-7635e5349aab) or a model-capacity error: ask Fable2; per Greg, same model, Resume after 5 minutes.

OTHER: TermAl's strict AcceptanceBindingEvidenceVerification lacks Engram's optional `bound` field (w-540531f46f53 C4). CLI --help: w-02f3bce82afe. After an OS crash SQLite can lose the last minutes of commits (Engram w-088e358107e0). A load-sensitive TermAl test needs a quiet machine (w-c009e0659697). termal_list_sessions fields vary by build (w-25199ca6ef59).

CODEX DELETE BLOCKED (TermAl w-ed7d67ec9514): a Codex integration owner's recursive delete in .logs, .evidence, target or .worktrees is refused "blocked by policy"; `git worktree remove` works. The Engram coordinator deletes those folders after a path check.

LAUNCHER NOTICE LOOKS LIKE THE OWNER: a launcher --notify result arrives with the RUN OWNER as sender ("PASS test-… results: …"); the owner has not seen it. The recipient relays it at once (rules-waits-and-wakes 1a). For Central Cargo runs, --notify goes to Termal::Fable2.
